query2_timestop_qdist.data_depth_note: Aug 2026 snapshots are ~1/day at 04:00Z (pre-entry), so August losers only have a following-day post-settlement snapshot (mid pinned ~0). Only Sep losers can carry a true pre-settlement time-stop quote. The adoptability verdict uses the next_window subset (real next-window quotes), not the post-settlement cross_day prices.

stitch.note: If the time-stop is adoptable, the bankroll simulation with time-stop exits is the final test. See report.
